name: DSBufferCaps
meaning: The DSBCAPS bits this module actually writes into DSBUFFERDESC.dwFlags. StaticSound uses SoundDevice_GetBufferLocFlags() | 0xE0; StreamSound hard-codes 0x101E0.

name: DSBCAPS_CTRLFREQUENCY
meaning: Required by Sound_SetBufferFrequency; set on every buffer this module creates.

name: DSBCAPS_CTRLPOSITIONNOTIFY
meaning: Streaming buffers only; required for IDirectSoundNotify.

name: DSBCAPS_GETCURRENTPOSITION2
meaning: Streaming buffers only; makes GetCurrentPosition report the accurate emulated cursor, which the playProgress accounting depends on.

name: SOUNDFLAGS_STATIC_CTRL
meaning: The CTRLFREQUENCY|CTRLPAN|CTRLVOLUME mask that StaticSound ORs onto the device's location flags.

name: SOUNDFLAGS_STREAM
meaning: The complete hard-coded flag word for every streaming buffer.
